capsuleQuantityGuidance.basis: Approximate amount for average density (Примерное необходимое количество капсул при наращивании (средняя густота)).
capsuleQuantityGuidance.caveat: Quantity depends on the density, length and texture of the customer’s own hair. Wavy/curly texture requires fewer capsules. No 40 cm quantity was supplied.

integrationNotes: Only normal resize/compression is needed; downloaded PNG/JPEG bytes have not been visually altered. Existing WEBPs were copied without changes.
Use first (primary=true) photo of each mapping list; alternates are retained only where the printed texture description differs.
Do not claim unpictured selector shades have an exact matching photo. Use an explicit gallery/reference fallback instead.

The Slavic-cut and capsule legacy galleries reuse visually matching hair photos under separate source URLs; mapping here confirms shade labels and source-gallery membership, not proof that capsule attachment hardware is visible.
European-cut label 6 reads ШОКОЛАД while dropdown reads Светло-коричневый / 6; the numeric code is exact.
Current clip-ins and mono order-based mappings align for their explicit codes. Clip-ins 613 needs only-name caution. Ponytail 1/613 is a separator-format candidate, not a strict literal match.
Published images are ordinary WebP compression only. Byte-identical source photos are shared between product galleries. No new variants or availability are inferred.
